_about: MAINNETSMOKE class -- real-mainnet confirmation that board+WC+kWallet is live, using kwallet-mainnet's KSIG-SALT-v1 scalar signer (QA-MAINNETSEND1, 2026-07-17). Unlike HBARXFER/WCNETSWITCH this spends real HBAR every run (transfer + node fee, ~0.0115 total) -- deliberately small, and balance-floor-guarded to skip (not fail) if the sender needs a top-up.
title: Board proposal-and-sign HBAR transfer on real mainnet

hard_assertions: mirror node confirms the EXACT board txid (not an amount/recipient match -- QA-MAINNETSEND1 run 1 false-PASSed that way once) with result SUCCESS
sender's mirror-node balance stays above MIN_BALANCE_TINYBAR (1 HBAR) -- run SKIPS rather than spending down to zero
oracle.benchmark: qa/harness/hbar-mainnet-send.cjs (2026-07-17 20:06Z, game MF778Q, txid 0.0.10650022-1784318772-996000000) -- first-ever real-mainnet pass of this flow, manual/investigative. mainnet-smoke-auto.cjs is the kflow-reporting automation of the same scenario, first run 2026-07-17 20:24Z (game FCNSFD, txid 0.0.10650022-1784319861-457000000), also SUCCESS.

network.note: the deliberate exception to HBARXFER/WCNETSWITCH's testnet-only rule -- real value is the point (proves the KSIG-SALT-v1 scalar signer + full board path work where it counts)

instances.benchmark: kflow run mainnetsmoke-*, commit 5ec6cd3, 2026-07-17 20:23-20:24 -- game FCNSFD, txid 0.0.10650022-1784319861-457000000, mirror SUCCESS.
